country.description: Target Etsy market. Sets the market URL locale and request language, so prices and ranking match the selected region (for example Germany returns EUR and Japan returns JPY).
country.title: Country / Market

includeDetails.description: Attempts to open each listing page for description, materials, tags, variations, images, and seller details. Etsy often blocks listing pages with DataDome. When that happens, rows are still returned with detailsStatus set to 'blocked' and the unavailable detail fields omitted; they are never filled with placeholders.
includeDetails.title: Include Listing Details

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to collect per URL or search query. A keyword market exposes at most 25 pages (about 200 listings); category URLs can expose more pages. Larger values return what Etsy exposes and report a partial result instead of pretending the request was complete.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Drop listings above this price in the selected market currency. 0 disables the upper bound.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Drop listings below this price in the selected market currency. Etsy does not expose a reliable server-side price filter on market pages, so this is applied to fetched cards. 0 disables the lower bound.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on Etsy. Each query is mapped to Etsy's market page (https://www.etsy.com/market/<slug>), the route that works without a browser or login. If Etsy redirects a keyword to a category page, the actor follows that category route. Each query is scraped as a separate task.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sortBy.description: Server-side Etsy ordering for market and category pages.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

starSellerOnly.description: Use Etsy's Star Seller market filter.
starSellerOnly.title: Star Seller only

startUrls.description: Etsy market URLs such as https://www.etsy.com/market/handmade_jewelry are the reliable route. Category URLs such as https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry also work and expose more cards per page. Legacy /search?q= URLs are converted to the matching market URL automatically. Shop and individual listing URLs are usually blocked by Etsy's DataDome protection; they are accepted for backward compatibility and reported as blocked instead of silently returning nothing.
startUrls.title: Etsy URLs
